fullPassage: Every time you conceptualize, categorize, and put a name on something that is not physical but rather consists of pure ideas, you should be aware of a simple fact. Your way of naming, categorizing, and conceptualizing is not the only possible way. Nor is it necessarily the best way. It is vital to recognize that other people from different backgrounds may organize the world and think about it differently. Their approach may be just as valid as yours. Indeed, depending on the context, it may be even more valid. It is easy to imagine that the way we think about the world is the only reasonable way. As long as all the people we interact with share the same concepts and models, it all seems to make sense. But when we interact with people from different cultures or different fields, our habitual thinking may be visible only as one of the many possible ways to carve the world up.

questions.passage: Every time you conceptualize, categorize, and put a name on something that is not physical but rather consists of pure ideas, you should be aware of a simple fact. Your way of naming, categorizing, and conceptualizing is not the only possible way. Nor is <u>it</u> necessarily the best way. It is vital to recognize that other people from different backgrounds may organize the world and think about it differently. Their approach may be just as valid as yours. Indeed, depending on the context, it may be even more valid. It is easy to imagine that the way we think about the world is the only reasonable way. As long as all the people we interact with share the same concepts and models, it all seems to make sense. But when we interact with people from different cultures or different fields, our habitual thinking may be visible only as one of the many possible ways to carve the world up.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 it이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은? ("it may be even more valid"의 it)

det.korean: Their approach may be just as valid. Indeed... it may be even more valid. → it = Their approach(다른 사람들의 접근법)
det.analysis:
✅ ① Their approach → it. 앞 문장의 Their approach를 받는 대명사 ←정답
❌ ② 명명하는 방식은 Your way로 이미 지칭됨
❌ ③ 순수한 아이디어는 이 문맥에서 지칭 대상 아님
❌ ④ 물리적 대상은 not physical로 부정됨
det.tip: Their approach may be just as valid → it(= their approach) may be even more valid
